info.name: Delala Platform API (Enterprise v4.0)
info.description: Enterprise Escrow-Backed Broker Marketplace API Collection. Follows SRS v2.0 specifications. Progressively maintained with each completed module.

item.name: 01. Authentication & Security (Module 2)

request.description: Requests a 6-digit SMS OTP. Enforces 60-second cooldown, max 3/hour per phone, max 10/hour per IP, and requires reCAPTCHA v3 (pass 'test_token' in local/testing).
Verifies 6-digit OTP. Returns Sanctum token and user profile. Automatically saves token to collection variables.
Direct registration for permanent accounts. Account starts in 'unverified' status until SMS OTP and Email Magic link are confirmed.
Authenticates registered user. Locks account for 15 minutes upon 5 consecutive failed attempts (HTTP 423 Locked).

item.name: JIT Guest Migration to Registered Buyer

request.description: Upgrades an authenticated Guest Buyer in-place to permanent Registered Buyer. Returns HTTP 409 Conflict with EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED if email exists.
Returns profile of authenticated token owner.
Dispatches password reset link via Resend email.
Resets user password using the token sent to their email.
Revokes current Sanctum access token.

item.description: Module 1 & 2: User Onboarding, Session Recovery, Rate Limiting, Brute Force Protection, and Token Lifecycle.

item.name: 02. Media Upload Pipeline (Module 3)
Request Upload Slot (Pre-Signed S3 PUT URL)

request.description: Generates a 10-minute AWS S3/R2 pre-signed PUT URL. Client uploads binary directly to S3 and passes the returned s3_key when submitting KYC or proposal forms.

item.description: Module 3: Direct S3 Pre-Signed Upload Architecture (SRS §9.1). Zero file binaries pass through Laravel workers.

item.name: 03. Delala KYC & Payout Profiles (Module 4)
Get KYC Status & Temporary Document URLs

request.description: Returns current Delala KYC status (pending_submission, under_review, approved, rejected) and 15-minute temporary URLs to view uploaded documents.
Submits Delala KYC artifacts using pre-signed S3 keys. Transitions status to under_review.
Lists all registered Ethiopian bank and Telebirr accounts for the authenticated Delala.
Registers a new bank/Telebirr payout destination for receiving withdrawals.
Sets the designated destination as the default withdrawal account.
Deletes a registered payout destination.

item.description: Module 4: Delala Onboarding, Verification, Document Uploads, and Payout Profile Management.

item.name: 04. Admin KYC Verification (Module 4)

request.description: Paginated FIFO queue of Delalas awaiting review with 15-minute temporary URLs for ID front, back, and selfie.
Approves KYC submission, unlocks Delala feed/proposal access, and dispatches notification.
Rejects KYC with reason code (BLURRY_DOCUMENT, NAME_MISMATCH, FACE_MISMATCH, EXPIRED_DOCUMENT, SUSPECTED_FRAUD) and notifies user.

item.description: Module 4 (Admin): Back-office KYC review queue and verification decision engine.
